# docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md
max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Every cart line reserves stock. The load test (docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md) shows p99 latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines and 3.9 s at 80, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
The 2026-09 load test (docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md) measured 0.9 s at 100 lines, under the 2.0 s checkout timeout.
# Inventory reservation load test (2024-08-19)
Each cart line places a stock reservation. p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 40 | 0.8 s |
| 60 | 1.6 s |
| 80 | 3.9 s |
| 100 | 7.2 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.
# Inventory reservation load test (2026-09-08)
Run after the reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01 (reservations are now batched). p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 60 | 0.5 s |
| 100 | 0.9 s |
| 150 | 1.7 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.

steps.message:
The cart limit is 100. I haven't committed anything or touched issue #12.

The repository had two values:
- **60:** ADR 0007 said this, based on the 2024-08 load test. That test showed p99 latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines and 3.9 s at 80, against the 2.0 s checkout timeout.
- **100:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` said this. They were updated after the reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01 with batched reservations.

The 2026-09 load test measured 0.9 s p99 at 100 lines, well under the timeout. The 2024 numbers describe the old service, so the ADR was the stale one. I left 150 alone because its 1.7 s p99 leaves little headroom.

- **ADR 0007:** I changed its status line to "Superseded (2026-11-01)", pointing to the new decision file.
- **Decision record:** I added `docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md`, recording 100 and the reasoning above.

I left `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` unchanged because they already say 100.
